card.title: Ukrainian
card.text: A full course from the alphabet to C1 in 76 modules, with stress marks throughout and 13 professional specializations.

heading: Learn Ukrainian, from the alphabet to C1.
lead: A complete course in standard Ukrainian in the 2019 spelling, written for English speakers. The cases, aspect, the vocative and the verbs of motion are explained directly, every answer gets feedback that says why, stress marks are shown throughout, and every Ukrainian word can be tapped for its forms and meaning.
fineprint: The whole course, the grammar reference and word practice are free. Specializations, stories, conversation practice, exam papers and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year. Also available for Russian speakers.

panel.label: The course, tier by tier

items.title: 1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: The alphabet, greetings, gender, the present tense, numbers.

items.title: 2 · First sentences
items.text: Adjectives, plurals, the locative and accusative, the past tense.

items.title: 3 · The cases and the future
items.text: Genitive, dative, instrumental, vocative, the future tenses, motion verbs.

items.title: 4 · Building fluency
items.text: Aspect, the imperative, reflexive verbs, every case in the plural.

items.title: 5 · Everyday fluency
items.text: Prefixed motion verbs, the conditional, complex sentences, numerals.

items.title: 6 · Intermediate
items.text: Participles, the -но/-то form, the passive, reported speech.

items.title: 7 · Upper intermediate
items.text: Verb government, impersonal sentences, euphony, society, law and media.

items.title: 8 · Advanced
items.text: Particles and word order, the 2019 orthography, style, literature.

panel.note: 76 modules in eight tiers, plus 13 professional specializations with 117 more modules.

items.title: The cases, one at a time
items.text: The locative and accusative come first, then the genitive, dative, instrumental and vocative, then every case in the plural and in adjectives, each with its endings set out and practised.

items.title: Aspect and motion verbs, in stages
items.text: Aspect returns in tiers 4, 6 and 8, and the verbs of motion in tiers 3 and 5 with their prefixes, so the hardest parts of the verb get more than one pass.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: Every answer gets feedback with the reason and a link to the grammar rule. The grammar reference has one page per rule, linked to the lessons that teach it.

items.title: Every word inspectable
items.text: Tap any Ukrainian word for its form, meaning, an example, its full table of forms and audio. Stress marks are shown throughout, so you learn where the stress falls from the start.

items.title: Common traps
items.text: Twelve short sets on the mistakes learners make, from false friends and cases after prepositions to aspect traps, the vocative and Russian interference. They are free.

items.title: No pronunciation scoring
items.text: Speech assessment does not cover Ukrainian, so the course has no pronunciation practice with feedback. Reading and listening texts have audio.

sections.heading: Ukrainian for your field
sections.intro: Thirteen professional courses of nine modules each, in three stages: foundations, working vocabulary and professional. Each stage opens when you reach tier 4, 6 or 8 of the main course.

items.question: Is the Ukrainian course free?
items.answer: Yes. All 76 modules, the grammar reference, word practice, the common traps and the placement test are free. Premium adds the specializations, stories, conversation practice, exam papers and the other extras.

items.question: Which Ukrainian does it teach?
items.answer: Standard Ukrainian in the 2019 spelling, with stress marks throughout. Tier 8 covers the 2019 orthography itself, style, spoken Ukrainian and literature.

items.question: Can I practise speaking?
items.answer: Not with pronunciation feedback: speech assessment does not cover Ukrainian. Premium has conversation practice with an AI character in everyday and work situations, and the reading and listening texts in the course have audio.

items.question: I already know some Ukrainian. Do I have to start at the beginning?
items.answer: No. Take the placement test and start at the tier it suggests.

items.question: I speak Russian. Is there a course for me?
items.answer: Yes. Ukrainian for Russian speakers is a shorter course, taught in Russian, that dwells on how Ukrainian differs from Russian.

closing.heading: Start with the alphabet, or with the placement test.
closing.text: Sign in with Google, take the placement test if you already know some Ukrainian, and open the first module.
